retrievalProfile.description: A vertical color-blocked sidebar layout that pairs a full-bleed nature photograph with a high-contrast typographic column.

recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-inspired layout featuring a large, lush green landscape photograph on the left two-thirds, abruptly bordered by a solid dark vertical sidebar on the right containing stacked, condensed sans-serif typography in contrasting white, yellow, and cyan.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical division between organic photography and geometric color block
Hierarchy established through color-coded text blocks
Scale contrast between tiny figures in the landscape and large display type
Color harmony between natural greens and synthetic cyan accents
coreInvariants: Solid vertical sidebar occupying approximately 30% of the width
Strictly left-aligned typography within the sidebar

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small human figures located in the bottom left quadrant of the photographic area, dwarfed by large trees.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid dark vertical column on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow display text, move down the list of secondary text, then sweep left into the deep photographic landscape.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dense foliage acts as textured negative space, while the dark sidebar provides structural negative space.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for main titles and cyan for secondary lists
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the sidebar; low value contrast within the textured green foliage.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Square-off curves in 'O' and 'G' to maximize verticality
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights, scales, and colors for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule (implied by text alignment)

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed 1960s display feel.
Provides the necessary grotesque structure for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a lush, slightly desaturated forest scene with a large tree trunk in the center-right and two small figures in the lower left. Leave the right 30% of the frame as a solid, dark charcoal-purple vertical rectangle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, stacked, extra-condensed yellow sans-serif text in the top half of the dark sidebar. Below it, place a list of smaller cyan sans-serif text, all left-aligned with a consistent margin.

verificationChecks: Is the sidebar a solid, dark color?
Is the main title text yellow and extra-condensed?
Are the figures in the photo small relative to the trees?
Is all text strictly left-aligned within the sidebar?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
The specific record label logo in the top center
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sidebar color is uniform and dark.
Check that the yellow text is the largest typographic element.
Verify the cyan text is organized as a vertical list.
Confirm the photograph feels like a 1960s film print.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [Nature/Urban Photo] + Add [30% Dark Sidebar on Right] + Overlay [Large Yellow Condensed Sans-Serif Title] + Add [Cyan Sans-Serif List Below].
